Keep the tab colors #7c5cbf for active and #8a8a8a for inactive."},{"element_id":"s14.e24","problem":"The janitor+ logo is drawn with a dark rectangular background box visible against the starry background. Do not add any dark fill behind it."},{"element_id":"s14","problem":"The background is a flat navy gradient with scattered dots. The title serif is also wrong: the mock is bolder and narrower.","fix":"Use a lighter blue-purple radial gradient (#1a2150 to #0c1030) with a few soft stars. Make the card fill rgba(255,255,255,0.04) with a 1px border rgba(255,255,255,0.15). Use a lighter, wider serif (Playfair or DM Serif style) for the heading, 32px, centered at y~60."},{"element_id":"s14.e25","problem":"The golden checkmark badge may not match the real asset at its rect.","fix":"Use assets/s14.e25.png at x=47.2, y=592, w=20.6, h=21.3."},{"element_id":"s14","problem":"The footer legal text and the checklist text are slightly off in line wrapping and position. The mock wraps the legal text differently.","fix":"Set the legal paragraph to 12px, centered, with line breaks after 'confirmation of', 'at the end of', and 'after'. Make the text 1px lower. Match the real link row 'Terms of Service • Privacy Policy • Restore Purchases' at y~794."},{"element_id":"s25","problem":"The Miro avatar is a blurry brown blob instead of the real portrait. The blue badge next to the name is a plain rectangle, not an eye icon.","fix":"Draw a 44x44 rounded avatar at x=4,y=125 with a warm dark green-brown portrait gradient (#3a2a1c to #6b7a4a). Replace the badge with a small blue eye glyph, 14x10, at x=95,y=131."},{"element_id":"s25","problem":"The body text wraps differently in the paragraphs. Real line 'He took up half the fucking cell even like' breaks before 'this.', and the mock has a different break, so lines drift. Text is also slightly heavier.","fix":"Set the paragraph width to about 300px (x=52 to 352), font-size 17px, weight 400, line-height 24.5px. Force the same line breaks as the real screen. Use #ffffff for body text, and #8d8d93 italic for the 'Count exits.' passages."},{"element_id":"s25","problem":"The disclaimer pill and the 'Aaditya' persona avatar are different. The mock's avatar is a flat tan/teal square, and the pill text is bolder.","fix":"Make the disclaimer pill text weight 400, 13px, color #b8b8c8, on a #3a3a45 fill. Make the Aaditya avatar a 24x24 rounded image with a dark teal background and a small face-like shape. Keep the name at weight 500."},{"element_id":"s06.e10","problem":"The part of the feed visible behind the drawer is shifted: the mock shows the card edge and the sparkle at wrong positions and sizes, and lacks the dim overlay.","fix":"Draw assets/s06.e10.art.png at x=0, y=319.3, w=68.5, h=188.1. Make the feed text behind the drawer match the real position; for example, the 'maller' line should be at x=0 and y=182. Add a dim overlay rgba(0,0,0,0.35) on the feed."},{"element_id":"s06","problem":"The drawer items are about 1px higher than the real ones, and the 'Media Library' icon is different. Make the banner x=128 to 410, h=55, with a starry navy gradient (#1b2a6b to #0c1a4a) and radius 10px. Put the arrow icon at x=388."},{"element_id":"s06.e60","problem":"The profile avatar might not be at the exact rect, and the hamburger icon at the top of the dimmed area is brighter than the real one.","fix":"Draw assets/s06.e60.png at x=120.4, y=19.8, w=77.7, h=59.4.
